props_7item368.title: Golem chest
props_7item368.identity: Detached bronze golem torso lying horizontally on its broad black hollow waist opening, neck toward the right. Stocky sculpted golden-bronze muscular chest with rounded pectoral/rib forms; flared blackened-metal waist rim edged with a row of brass rivets; narrow round neck stub surrounded by a distinctive blue-and-gold checked collar. Only the torso component: no head, arms, legs or stand.
props_7item368.materials: Golden bronze torso and rivets, blackened iron waist rim and interior, blue cloth and gold checked collar. Wear is fine and restrained.

props_7item371.title: Golem left leg
props_7item371.identity: One detached articulated LEFT bronze golem leg, complete from broad rounded thigh through knee and narrow shin to its small angular metal foot. It lies horizontally, thigh end on the RIGHT, toe/foot on the LEFT, as in the reference icon. Gold bronze sculpted muscle-like thigh and calf; blackened iron ankle band and small rivets. No torso, second leg or mannequin.
props_7item371.materials: Warm worn gold bronze thigh, calf and foot; blackened iron ankle cuff and joint seams; all opaque metal.

props_7item372.title: Golem right leg
props_7item372.identity: One detached articulated RIGHT bronze golem leg, complete from rounded thigh through knee, narrow lower shin and ankle to a tall angular upturned metal foot. It lies horizontally, large thigh on the LEFT and foot at the RIGHT, as in the reference icon. The foot has a raised pointed toe, not a flat missing stump. Gold bronze sculpted muscle-like forms with a black iron ankle band. No torso, second leg or mannequin.
props_7item372.materials: Warm gold bronze thigh, calf and angular foot, darkened iron ankle cuff, worn metal patina.

props_7item373.title: Golem right arm
props_7item373.identity: One detached mechanical RIGHT golem arm lying horizontally, broad hollow rounded shoulder cup at the RIGHT, articulated upper arm and elbow in the middle, wrist cuff and an OPEN THREE-PRONG CLAW at the LEFT. The claw has three distinct curved opposing bronze pincers, not a human hand. Short blackened-iron corrugated joint bands separate bronze armour segments. No torso or second limb.
props_7item373.materials: Golden bronze segmented armour and pincer claw, blackened iron joint bands, dark shoulder interior; all metal.

props_7item374.title: Golem left arm
props_7item374.identity: One detached LEFT bronze golem arm lying horizontally: broad rounded shoulder end at the LEFT, tapering sculpted upper arm, elbow and forearm, black iron wrist cuff, and a complete articulated humanoid bronze hand at the RIGHT. The hand has five separate digits with thumb and curled fingers, palm curved upward as in the icon. Synthetic bronze muscle forms, no flesh, no torso or second limb.
props_7item374.materials: Brown-gold bronze arm and hand with subtle patina, darker blackened-iron wrist band; all opaque metal.

props_harp.title: Harp
props_harp.identity: A single small medieval fantasy harp with a triangular open frame made of warm orange-brown carved wood. Thick RIGHT pillar is carved as an integral stylised human head and flowing human figure, ending at the curved base; a thinner curving LEFT pillar has scrolling ornament; upper neck slopes upward toward the right pillar. Fine separate straight brass strings span the open frame. The wood carving is part of the harp, not a separate human. No stand or other instruments.
props_harp.materials: Warm honey-brown carved walnut wood, fine dark grain in the sculpture, brass strings and tiny brass tuning pegs.

props_horn.title: Horn of Ros
props_horn.identity: Horn of Ros: a single curved animal drinking/blowing horn, slender pointed upturned tip on the LEFT and a large open flared circular mouth on the RIGHT. Dark brown-black horn body with two narrow bands and a broad engraved silver mouth rim. A thin gold carrying cord hangs in a shallow triangle between tip-side attachment and the main band. Show the hollow mouth clearly. No trumpet valves, no handle, no pedestal.
props_horn.materials: Dark brown to charcoal natural horn with subtle grain; engraved silver and brass metal bands and mouth rim; gold cord. Dark interior is a real cavity, not painted shine.

props_item267.title: Urn of Ashes
props_item267.identity: Urn of Ashes: an upright lidded golden funerary urn, round broad foot, short stem and bulbous cup body. Large sculpted grimacing skull mask with curled ram horns, deep eye sockets, nose and teeth on the FRONT. Two matching round loop handles, one at each side. Round domed lid closes the vessel and has one small finial. Only this urn, no ashes, smoke, fire or stand.
props_item267.materials: Worn warm gold bronze over the entire urn, including skull relief, curled horns, handles, lid and foot; darkened metal in genuine recesses.

props_item276.title: Sarcophagus of Korbu
props_item276.identity: Sarcophagus of Korbu: a long low rectangular closed STONE sarcophagus lying on its base. Thick overhanging bevelled lid. Long front wall has a large central carved grimacing bearded vampire/ogre face in the stone. Two symmetrical square recessed panels flank it, each with an eight-pointed star/cross carving and a small round bronze ring handle. Narrow interlaced knotwork strips at the ends. Preserve long horizontal chest proportions. No body, skeleton, legs or separate ornaments.
props_item276.materials: Weathered muted olive-grey stone with small pits and carved knotwork. Only the two ring handles are warm bronze metal. The face is stone, not flesh or gold.

props_memcryst.title: Memory Crystal Alpha
props_memcryst.identity: A single oval, thick, polished violet Memory Crystal, lying on its broad convex back. The FRONT contains an integral sculpted calm human face/mask: smooth brow, deep narrow eyes, small long nose, closed lips and cheekbones inside the oval rim. The face is made from the same violet crystal as the body, not a real human head inside glass. Substantial rounded volume, no holes through the eyes, no neck, stand, limbs or jewellery.
props_memcryst.materials: Purple-violet translucent-looking polished mineral with cloudy lavender internal colour variations. Face and rim share the same vitreous material. Keep it opaque for the game, no painted specular hotspots.

props_lockpick.title: Lock Pick
props_lockpick.identity: One brown leather roll-top/drawstring pouch standing on its rounded bottom, holding a small set of lock-picking tools projecting from the open mouth. Several thin steel picks and gold-brass rods at different heights, including one large curved steel hook at the RIGHT and a thin hooked pick at the LEFT. A distinctive small silver three-loop knot emblem decorates the front of the pouch. The body is supple worn leather with folds and visible seams. No hand, separate tools on the floor or stand.
props_lockpick.materials: Warm ochre-brown worn leather pouch and drawstring; dark silver steel hook and picks; brass tool handles; silver three-loop knot emblem. Separate metal from leather.

props_amber.title: Amber
props_amber.identity: One pointed elongated teardrop shard of golden-orange AMBER, broad rounded upper end and very long narrow downward taper, lying on its broad back. A small dark grey-brown trapped winged insect is visible in the central upper chamber through the honey-coloured resin. The insect is a small inclusion fully inside the amber, not a separate animal sitting on its exterior. Angular but softly worn edges, no setting, chain or stand.
props_amber.materials: Honey-orange amber resin with subtle warm variation, darker rust edge, small dark trapped insect inclusion. Opaque game albedo can imply depth; avoid glass reflections or black shine.
